div.head: I Cn 4.2
div.ab: Mycel is seo halsung ⁊ mære is seo halgung, þe deofla afyrsað ⁊ on fleame gebringeð, swa oft swa man fullað oððe husel halgað; ⁊ halige englas þær abutan hwearfiað ⁊ þa dæda beweardiað ⁊ þurh Godes mihta þam sacerdon fylstað, swa oft swa hig Criste deniað mid rihte.

Micel is seo halsung ⁊ mære is seo halgung, þe he deofla afyrseð ⁊ on fleame gebringeð, swa oft swa he man fullað oððe husl halgað; and englas þær hwearfiað ⁊ þa dæda bewerdiað ⁊ þurh Godes mihta þam sacerdon fylstað, swa oft swa hig Criste ðeniað mid rihte.

Et magna coniuratio multaque benedictio est, quę diabolum semouet (propellit di.) et in fugam redigit, quotiens diuina potentia operante (cooperante potentia), beatorum spirituum prosequente custodia, per manus temporalium sacerdotum sacri baptismatis uel eucharistiæ sacrosancta misteria celebrantur.

Mycel is seo halsung ⁊ mære is seo halgung þe deofla afyrsað ⁊ on fleame gebringeð, swa oft swa man fullað oððe husel halgað; ⁊ halige englas þær abutan hwearfiað ⁊ þa dæda beweardiað ⁊ þurh Godes mihta þam sacerdon fylstað, swa oft swa hi Criste ðeniað mid rihte.

Mycel is seo halsung and mære is seo halgung þe deofla afyrsað and on fleame gebringeð, swa oft swa man fullað oððe husel halgað; and halige englas þær abutan hwearfiað and þa dæda beweardiað and þurh Godes mihta þam sacerdon fylstað swa oft swa hig Criste ðeniað mid rihte.

Gross ist die Beschwörung und hehr ist die Weihe, welche (durch w. er A) Teufel austreibt und zur Flucht bringt, so oft wie getauft oder die Hostie geweiht wird (wie er einen Menschen tauft o. d. H. weiht A); und (heilige G) Engel schweben dort (umher G) und beschützen die [Weihe]-Handlungen und helfen kraft Gottesmacht den Priestern, so oft wie diese Christo ordnungsgemäss dienen.

Great is the exorcism and glorious the consecration by which (he, A) drives out devils and puts them to flight, as often as baptism is given or the host consecrated (as he baptises someone or consecrates the host, A); and (holy, G) angels hover there (round about, G) and guard the [sacred] acts and through God's might help the priests, as often as they serve Christ rightly.

Great is the exorcising and wonderful is the hallowing through which he drives away devils and puts them to flight, as often as he baptises anyone or hallows the Eucharist; and holy angels hover round there and protect these acts, and, through the power of God, help the priests as often as they serve Christ as they ought.

Great is the exorcising and wondrous is the sanctifying by which devils are cast out and brought to flight, just as often as he baptizes anyone or consecrates the Eucharist; and holy angels hover about that place and watch over those deeds, and through the power of God they assist the priests just as often as they serve Christ properly.
div.note: ‘halige’ and ‘abutan’ are probably G's additions (missing from A, Ld and the Polity).
þe deofla: þe he deofla A
swa man: swa he man A
